watches.name: Planetary
watches.description: Showcasing a hand painted planetary dial, each Planetary is unique as no two dials are ever created the same. The dial and handset create a sharp contrast, similar to what one might observe in the vast expanse of space. NH38A movement (no ghost date position),100m WR, a fully brushed case with screw down crown and a double domed sapphire crystal, this watch is more than just a pretty face. Available in 36 or 38mm. The 38mm has a lug to lug of 45mm while the 36mm version has a lug to lug of 43mm. Both versions share the same thickness of 11mm excluding the domed sapphire crystal.

watches.name: Expedition 36
watches.description: Presenting the Expedition 36 - a 36mm unisex watch with a sleek, compact profile that’s designed to fit any wrist comfortably. With a screw-down crown and water resistance up to 100 meters, it’s built to keep up with all your adventures. The Jubilee bracelet, featuring solid, screwed links, balances durability with a refined, classic look. Choose from two dial options: a bright, refreshing aqua blue or a soft sage green, both options get the same treatment of a white second hand for some added contrast with the dial.

watches.name: Vanguard GMT
watches.description: The Vanguard GMT features a water resistance rating of 200m and the capability to monitor a second time zone, making it the perfect watch for frequent travelers who require the ability to track multiple time zones. Now available in rose or steel, both versions present a mix of both brushed and polished finishing to the case and a highly polished chapter ring, elevating the overall aesthetic and refinement of the already popular Vanguard Black GMT. Each version showcases applied markers, generously filled with Swiss Super-Luminova® BGW9, and C3 hands to ensure exceptional luminosity in low-light environments.

watches.name: Chromatic GMT
watches.description: Introducing the Chromatic GMT. This watch stands as our most distinctive offering yet. Boasting a GMT movement, it ensures precise timekeeping across multiple time zones. With a water resistance of 200 meters, it's ready for any adventure, from deep-sea dives to high-altitude excursions. The distinguishing feature of the Chromatic GMT lies in its captivating high gloss rainbow enamel dial. Handcrafted with care, every dial goes through a meticulous process involving the application of thin layers of powdered glass onto a metal base, followed by exposure to high temperatures. The outcome is a stunning deep finish with an almost tangible three-dimensional allure, embodying the epitome of luxury and refinement.

watches.name: Abyss Diver
watches.description: Functionality takes the spotlight in the Abyss Diver, featuring a tactical design and impressive 200m diving capability. At the heart of this timepiece lies the forged carbon fiber dial. In the world of watchmaking, forged carbon fiber stands as a revered material for its modernity and resilience. Unlike traditional carbon fiber, which is woven from individual fibers, forged carbon fiber is crafted by combining carbon fibers with resin and subjecting the blend to intense pressure. The result? A unique flaked texture gracing each dial, adding a touch of individuality to every timepiece produced.

watches.name: Machina
watches.description: Brand new release for winter 2022, a timepiece designed with day to day duties in mind. Featuring 100m water resistance, screw down crown and a sapphire exhibition cashback, this watch looks just as at home under a shirt cuff as it does with your favourite pair of joggers. The case is a very wearable 40.5mm (excluding 'ears') with a 47mm lug to lug and a thickness of just 12mm, making this watch suitable for a wide range of wrist sizes. The inner workings comprise of a Seiko NH72A 'Skeleton' automatic movement featuring a gunmetal finish, 24 jewels and hand winding / hacking functionality. Every movement is regulated in-house to ensure the best accuracy possible is achieved. The watch is finished with a flat sapphire crystal complete with an anti-reflective inner treatment to minimise glare. The black variant features a fully matte black beadblasted exterior and a brushed chapter ring while the rose version opts for a polished / brushed case and a high polish chapter ring. Each watch comes fitted with a high quality FKM rubber band and a buckle to match the chosen case finish.

watches.name: Expedition 40
watches.description: Introducing our first ever 40mm watch - the Expedition 40, a vintage-inspired GMT with a comfortably slim case profile, measuring under 12mm thick. Designed to suit wrists of all sizes, this watch combines classic aesthetics with modern functionality. Crafted for adventure, the Expedition 40 boasts a water resistance of 100m, ensuring reliability in various environments. Its box domed sapphire crystal offers superior durability and clarity, while the fully brushed case with high-polished bevels adds a touch of refinement to its rugged charm. Adding a playful twist to its iconic design, both versions of the Expedition 40 feature a captivating snowflake dial, available in either air force blue or pine green.

watches.name: Skeleton II
watches.description: Introducing the Skeleton II, where style meets functionality. With its ceramic bezel, screw-down crown, and skeletonised dial and movement, this watch is a blend of sophistication and practicality. At the heart of its design lies the NH72 skeleton movement, displaying its intricate inner mechanisms. The iconic Mercedes-style handset not only ensures clear legibility but also illuminates in low-light environments, adding to its versatility. Choose between the rose, black or matte steel version, each showcasing a sapphire crystal and caseback. With a water resistance of 100m and a screw-down crown, the Skeleton II is ready for any adventure

watches.name: Subhunter
watches.description: The Subhunter features a cocktail of design influence from some of the most legendary diver's watches. Employing ceramic and sapphire materials and a 200m waterproof rating, a vintage inspired watch without the pitfalls of vintage watch reliability. Showcasing a fade-to-grey fumé dial and Swiss Super-Luminova GL old radium markers, the Subhunter is a nod to classic diver watches from yesteryear. Two versions to choose from: Classic: Mercedes style handset and a submariner style insert Military: Sword handset and a fully indexed bezel insert
